adjudication.rationale: Looking at the diff, parseRefreshTokenResponse in packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/parseRefreshTokenResponse.ts returns the result of safeParse (lines 14-18), which is an object with {success, data, error} structure. In GoogleCalendarService.ts line 97, the code does `const key = parseRefreshTokenResponse(googleCredentials, googleCredentialSchema);` and then passes `key` directly to prisma.credential.update. This stores the safeParse envelope {success: true, data: {...}} instead of just the data. The next time the credential is loaded, googleCredentialSchema.parse() will fail because it expects the actual credential shape, not the envelope. This is a real bug.
